changeSet.author: rspace
changeSet.comment: Allow future extra-field names to exceed the legacy varchar limit. The runtime catalog still publishes only names up to 128 characters, so its indexes can use that bounded prefix.

changeSet.author: rspace
changeSet.comment: Index the published name prefix, deletion flag, and subtype used by runtime-field discovery.
changeSet.sql: CREATE INDEX ix_extrafield_name_deleted ON ExtraField (name(128), deleted, DTYPE)

changeSet.author: rspace
changeSet.comment: Index the owning instrument followed by the published name prefix and deletion flag.
changeSet.sql: CREATE INDEX ix_extrafield_instr_name ON ExtraField (instrumentEntity_id, name(128), deleted)
